name: EdThumb
original_description: Create YouTube and Shorts thumbnails by chatting with ChatGPT. Pick from 300+ ready-made styles in a visual gallery, use the characters you saved (your face, with high fidelity) and describe the video in one sentence. Link your channel and choose 3 reference thumbnails: EdThumb learns your channel's visual identity (text style, colors, effects) and keeps new thumbnails consistent with it, without copying. Adjust directly in the editor by marking areas on the image, move elements and compare versions. To find out what converts, generate 3 variations with different ideas for YouTube's Test & Compare and mark the winner: EdThumb learns what works on your channel. Thumbnails are saved to your EdThumb projects. Requires an EdThumb account.
